Build a weather widget

In this tutorial you will build a small widget that shows the current temperature for any city.

Beginner · 20 minutes

Steps

  1. Create a new folder and open it in your editor.

  2. Add an HTML file with a single heading and an empty list.

  3. Press Ctrl + S to save, then reload the browser tab.

Show a hint

Remember to wrap the request in a try block so that network errors do not break the page.
